body:
The implementation looks fine overall, but it's going to be annoying to review. The logic of some nodes have various changes that have chance to introduce regressions.

I think this shouldn't expose any methods in SceneTree. The PR is about adding sounds to GUI nodes, so it should do only that, and provide a method inside Control/Window to play a sound. Stuff like exposing scene tree audio players can be done later. Note that performance isn't a concern here, because no Control plays any sound by default, so the feature by itself will not make cause any problems on that front until you actually use it (and even then it's not that terrible).

Some issues I found:
- Theme editor previews don't play sound.

Potential missing sounds (can be for follow-up PR):
- SpinBox does not have any sounds for dragging the value.
- ColorPicker could have sounds for keyboard navigation. Also maybe for picking the from screen?
- LineEdit/TextEdit could get sounds for moving the caret.
- Tree has various internal controls, like text boxes, buttons, checkboxes, combo boxes and sliders. Though not sure if it's worth it adding sound for every of them.
- TabContainer (TabBar) has no sound for keyboard navigation.

Minor details left, but otherwise looks fine.

Didn't test all the sounds.
Code style looks good, haven't tested
